experiment_identity_basis: Deposited MasterFigures_Control.m explicitly defines Exp 1 tumour data as GFPOrlando, Exp 2 as 6-6-11_Tumor_Tracking_Data, and Exp 3 as 3-14-11_Tumor_Tracking_Data.
Deposited README identifies GFPOrlando.mat as tumour-cell tracking data from the c1 5-16-11 movie and states that tumour/GFP and microglia/TAM tracking are stored separately.
The README also mentions 3-4-14C2 in the separate PIV/supplementary-movie context; this schema lock does not equate that PIV label with the explicitly named Exp 3 single-cell tracking member.
schema_evidence.column_semantics_basis: Deposited MATLAB analysis code defines Cells = unique(StoreData(:,2)), time = StoreData(r,1), x = StoreData(r,3), and y = StoreData(r,4).
schema_evidence.time_unit_basis: Deposited analysis labels time as hours and the XLS elapsed-time examples agree with StoreData hour-valued samples; canonical normalization therefore multiplies source time by 60 to minutes.
schema_evidence.coordinate_unit_basis: Deposited analysis uses StoreData x/y directly for displacement and labels MSD in micrometre-squared units; plotting code converts the same x/y values to image pixels with Ctrl.pixelscale. Coordinates are therefore normalized with scale 1.0 to micrometres.
schema_evidence.frame_rule_basis: The deposited source has irregular acquisition intervals in some experiments. Canonical frame is therefore the deterministic sorted rank of each distinct global elapsed-time value, while the exact source elapsed time is retained for dt calculations. No fixed interval is imposed and no method outcome is consulted.

experiment_1.cell_type_identity: tumour/glioma by dedicated GFPOrlando tumour-data member identity
experiment_1.inclusion_rule: all observations in the unambiguously tumour-only GFPOrlando StoreData matrix with finite x/y/time and non-empty track identity; no method-performance-based exclusions

experiment_2.cell_type_identity: tumour/glioma by dedicated Tumor_Tracking_Data member identity
experiment_2.inclusion_rule: all observations in the unambiguously tumour-only 6-6-11 StoreData matrix with finite x/y/time and non-empty track identity; no method-performance-based exclusions

experiment_3.cell_type_identity: tumour/glioma by dedicated Tumor_Tracking_Data member identity
experiment_3.inclusion_rule: all observations in the unambiguously tumour-only 3-14-11 StoreData matrix with finite x/y/time and non-empty track identity; no method-performance-based exclusions

freeze_rule: This mapping was frozen and committed after schema-only source inventory/documentation/code inspection and before any Dryad confirmatory method-performance calculation. Any later source-format failure must stop the pipeline rather than trigger outcome-guided remapping or retuning.
